display.purpose: View titles and the slide-over heading.

headline.purpose: Section and workspace titles, with a line badge beside job and client names.

title.purpose: Panel sub-headings and names inside lists and rows.

body.purpose: Running text; meta lines drop to 12px in Text Dim. Arabic opens the line height to 1.7.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase mono over fields, directories, facts and every column head. Arabic removes the tracking and the transform.

numeral.purpose: Badge contents, counts, scores and years in tabular Plex Mono; 12px in funnel stops, 13px in score boxes.

shadows.name: shadow-panel
shadows.purpose: The detail slide-over. Dark: 0 24px 56px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4).

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: Toasts and popovers. Dark: 0 14px 36px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3).

shadows.name: ring-focus
shadows.purpose: Input, select and textarea focus halo, with the border turning violet.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entries and presses: overlay entry at 240ms, button press at 160ms.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on hover.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: transform: scale(0.97) on :active (0.94 for icon buttons).

motion.name: duration-overlay
motion.purpose: Slide-over and toast entry via @starting-style, translate 24px from the inline end (-24px in RTL).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every transition collapses to 0.01ms except a 120ms fade for overlays; the entry translate is removed.

narrative.overview:
Qumaa is an offline recruiting desk for agency headhunters, and its interface borrows from Riyadh's bilingual transit wayfinding: a graphite header band in both themes, line badges that give every job, client, pipeline stage and review state a colour that means something, and a hiring funnel drawn as a line of stops with a ringed 'you are here'. The world lends exactly four things (type, palette, density and that one signature move); navigation, layout and controls remain standard desktop web, because the recruiter is completing tasks on a laptop in the evening or on the move, often in Arabic.

Density follows a station board: generous rows with strong one-pixel separation, tabular numerals in boxes, and small tracked mono labels over everything that is a field. Surfaces are flat and layered by tone, not shadow; shadows appear only on things that float (the slide-over, toasts). Light, dark and Arabic RTL are equals: the same tokens, the same shapes, with the mono labels losing their tracking in Arabic because connected script cannot be spaced.

Confirmed rejections: the generic SaaS dashboard arrangement of grey sidebar, white cards and kanban; anything that looks AI-generated; consumer-app softness.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite chrome derived from brand ink, in light and dark alike
Eight line colours that each do a job; identity lines and state lines never swap roles
Rounded-square badges for identity and stops, pills with a dot for states, one shape each
IBM Plex Sans at signage weights, Plex Mono for every number and label
Flat surfaces separated by 1px rules and tonal strips; shadows only on overlays
Bilingual by construction: RTL mirrors the layout, identity strings stay isolated inline

rules.name: The Line Does a Job Rule
rules.body: A line colour appears only when it names an identity or a state. Green, amber and red are never identities; violet, blue, teal and orange are the only identity lines, assigned by hash, never by hand.

rules.name: The Chrome Is Ink Rule
rules.body: The header band is graphite derived from brand ink in both themes; the light theme's identity comes from that contrast, so the band never turns white or paper.

rules.name: The Connected Script Rule
rules.body: Arabic is never tracked, never uppercased and never set in the mono face; `:root[lang='ar']` resets letter-spacing and text-transform on every label, heading and badge and swaps the mono stack for Plex Sans Arabic.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any number a recruiter compares (score, count, years, salary) is set in Plex Mono with tabular figures so columns line up.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element floats above the work; a card, table, badge or button at rest never carries one.

rules.name: The One Shape Each Rule
rules.body: Identity and stops are rounded squares; states are pills with a 7px dot; scores are boxes. The shapes are never swapped, so a recruiter reads the kind of thing before the words.

dos: Do give every job, client, stage and state its line badge or pill before its words; the colour is read first.
Do keep identity lines to violet, blue, teal and orange assigned by hash, and reserve green, amber and red for states.
Do set every label and column head in Plex Mono 10.5px, 500, uppercase, 0.24em, and every compared number in tabular Plex Mono.

Do isolate short identity strings (names, titles, file names, locations, client context) with an inline `<bdi>` inside start-aligned blocks, and let prose blocks (notes, passages, quotes, raw text) take their own direction with `dir="auto"`.
Do gate hover styles behind `(hover: hover)`, press buttons to scale(0.97) over 160ms, enter overlays with `@starting-style`, and collapse all motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do theme the surfaces nobody draws: scrollbars in Border Strong, selection in Violet Wash, the caret in violet.
donts: Don't put a shadow on a card, table, badge or button at rest; depth is tone and 1px rules.
Don't track, uppercase or mono-set Arabic text; the connected script keeps its natural spacing and a 1.7 line height.
Don't nest a card inside a card or add a coloured side border thicker than 1px; a quoted passage is a tinted block with a 1px start rule.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or icon fonts for icons; icons are inline SVG that mirror in RTL when directional.
Don't rebuild the generic SaaS arrangement (grey sidebar, white cards, kanban) or soften the system toward consumer apps; the station board, the funnel line and the graphite chrome are the identity.
Don't add fonts or any network asset; the three Plex families ship with the app.
